capabilities: Render Markdown notes as paginated 3:4 image cards in a live preview
Choose among 25 templates and apply color palettes
Adjust typography, sizes, padding, and reading presets
Copy a card or export single PNGs and a ZIP of all cards
Configure profile, cover, and export scale
disambiguation: Not a publishing or sharing tool; it renders notes locally into image files and does not upload or publish anything.
extras: Interface labels are in Chinese; README notes an unresolved environment-specific Copy/PNG failure tracked in issue 11, and that fonts use installed system fonts so rendering may vary across devices. There is a separate design-test build with a different plugin ID whose settings do not carry over.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into styled image cards for sharing on Xiaohongshu; notes must be reformatted by hand in other tools.
summary: Markdown-to-image renderer that turns notes into 1080×1440 Xiaohongshu (RED) card sets with templates, palettes, and PNG/ZIP export.
